questions.content:
Total number of essential amino acid among the given list of amino acids is ________.

Arginine, Phenylalanine, Aspartic acid, Cysteine, Histidine, Valine, Proline

en.content:
Total number of essential amino acid among the given list of amino acids is ________.

Arginine, Phenylalanine, Aspartic acid, Cysteine, Histidine, Valine, Proline
